plugins.name: specialist
plugins.description: Full-cycle feature development skills: business spec → system analysis → per-repository decomposition → work plan → spec-driven implementation → acceptance → documentation

plugins.name: specialist-analyst
plugins.description: The analyst role of the specialist framework — a raw task to business, system, and per-repository specs, and documentation that stays true to the code. Skills-only plugin; the guards ship with the full specialist bundle.

plugins.name: specialist-dev
plugins.description: The developer role of the specialist framework — a repo spec to spec-driven code: implementation plans, tests-first minimal implementation, conventions, bug root-causing. Skills-only plugin; the guards ship with the full specialist bundle.

plugins.name: specialist-qa
plugins.description: The QA/reviewer role of the specialist framework — spec-side test analysis (holes, missed criteria, corner cases), test design, acceptance against the specs, live-stand acceptance, quality review, adversarial bug and security hunting, defect triage. Skills-only plugin; the guards ship with the full specialist bundle.
